samenvatting: I'm Marit, I'm 15 and I'm in Year 11 (VWO 4) at the Eckartcollege in Eindhoven. I love board games, puzzles, maths competitions and chess. Curious who'll be sailing on the Thalassa?
intro: I'm Marit and I'm 15 years old. I'm in Year 11 (VWO 4) at the Eckartcollege in Eindhoven. I live with my parents and my two sisters, who are 12 and 16.
tekst:
Games

I absolutely love playing games. That's why we have loads of them at home – two big cupboards full! One of my favourites is Rummikub. I love it because it isn't too complicated, so you can play it with anyone. But you really do have to think hard and puzzle things out.

Maths competitions

I really enjoy maths competitions. That's where puzzling and logical reasoning come in handy again. I love the Kangaroo competition, the Bebras challenge and the Mathematical Olympiad. Last year I even reached the national finals of both the Bebras challenge and the Mathematical Olympiad.

Chess

I also play chess. I had chess lessons from the age of 5 to 11. I don't play as much as I used to, but I still enter the odd tournament now and then, which I really enjoy.

Hockey and Formula 1

I love watching hockey – I played it myself for 9 years. I also really enjoy watching Formula 1. I can get completely absorbed in it, so I'm definitely going to miss that when I'm at sea for six months.
